# BEAR.Security

> Security scanner for BEAR.Sunday applications with OWASP Top 10 compliance

## Overview

BEAR.Security is a PHP security vulnerability scanner designed for BEAR.Sunday framework applications. It provides static (SAST), dynamic (DAST), and AI-powered application security testing with 100% OWASP Top 10 coverage.

## Quick Start

```bash
composer require --dev bear/security
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src
```

## Key Features

- 14 SAST detectors (SQL Injection, XSS, Command Injection, Path Traversal, etc.)
- DAST with Security Headers analysis
- AI Auditor via Claude API (IDOR, Race Conditions, Mass Assignment)
- OWASP Top 10 checklist reports
- SARIF output for GitHub Security integration
- Psalm taint analysis enabled

## Documentation

- README: /README.md

## Main Components

- Scanner: src/Scanner.php
- Detectors: src/Detector/ (14 detectors)
- DAST: src/Dast/
- AI Auditor: src/Ai/
- Reports: src/Report/
- CLI: bin/bear.security-scan, bin/bear-security-audit
